CVE-2026-120740.title: hivex: hivex: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read in big-data block processing
CVE-2026-120740.description: A flaw was found in hivex. By supplying a specially crafted Windows registry hive file, an attacker can trigger an out-of-bounds memory read when hivex parses registry values containing malformed large data block lists. This issue can cause the application processing the registry file to crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).
